name: self_coder
description: Autonomous self-improvement of the app's own CODE. Signals (debugger findings, failed turns) become Aider-edited branches that are verified (compile + boot + optional tests) before they can land. Auto-stashes dirty working trees so a session never blocks the loop; retries on verify failure with the error fed back to Aider. Core changes need human approval; small plugin-only changes can auto-merge. Canary deploy auto-rolls-back if the app doesn't come up.

settings.label: Max retries when verification fails (Aider sees the error and tries again)
Run full pytest in verify (slow but safer)
